description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Ra, implementing a custom wrapper around SVN::Ra for use in git-svn, including caching, version compatibility, and repository interaction functions.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl class providing a customized, cached, and version-compatible wrapper around SVN::Ra for git-svn interactions.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of Git::SVN::Ra with URL canonicalization and optional caching.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Getter/setter for the repository URL, ensuring it is canonicalized.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks the existence and type of a path in the repository, with internal caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory listings with caching and compatibility handling for different SVN versions.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves logs over a range of revisions with custom path processing and support for limitations.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Checks if two directory trees match, primarily for older SVN versions.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Gets a commit editor, adjusting behavior based on SVN version.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an SVN update operation with custom path handling.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs an SVN switch operation, reparenting if necessary.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Calculates the longest common directory path among given SVN glob objects.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Fetches SVN logs iteratively, handling deletions and revisions.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively retrieves directory entries up to a specified depth.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Returns a shortened, canonical URL relative to the repository root.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Checks whether the SVN ra_reparent/switch operation is supported in the current SVN version.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN errors by ignoring certain revision-related errors.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a reference path should be ignored based on regex patterns.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches directory entries against glob patterns, possibly requiring subtree fetches.
